treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Hungary and the Republic of Albania for the avoidance of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and on capital (1992)
eif_quote: [DPT treaty table] HUNGARI, Ligj 7686, 15.03.1993, Fletorja Zyrtare 4/09.04.1993, Me efekte nga data 01.01.1996 | Art. 29(2): The Convention shall enter into force upon the exchange of instruments of ratification and its provisions shall have effect: (a) in Albania: - in respect of income derived on or after the first day of the calendar year following that of the entry into force of the Convention; (b) in Hungary: (i) in respect of taxes withheld at source, to amounts of income derived on or after 1 January in the calendar year next following the year in which the Convention enters into force [EIF date 1995-12-21 from map.json]
source_title: Hungarian Ministry (kormany.hu) synthesised text of the MLI and the Hungary–Albania Convention (English authentic) — Wayback copy of the official PDF

rates.quote: (a) 5% of the gross amount of the dividends if the recipient is a company which holds directly at least 25% of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
(b) 10% of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
(1) Interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

(2) However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5% of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: The following paragraph 1 of Article 7 of the MLI applies and supersedes the provisions of this Convention: Notwithstanding any provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude ... that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction ... | the provisions of the MLI have effect ... with respect to taxes withheld at source on amounts paid or credited to non-residents, where the event giving rise to such taxes occurs on or after 1 January 2022

notes: Royalty definition includes industrial, commercial or scientific equipment rental. Interest taxable only in residence State (no source tax). MLI Art. 8 not applicable (Hungary reserved Art. 8(3)(a)). English is the only authentic language ("Done in duplicate at Tirana, this 14th day of November 1992, in the English language"); tatime.gov.al Albanian translation (shkarko id 350) consistent: 5%/25%, 10%, interest exclusive, royalties 5%.
